The cat has a neutral, focused expression with small black eyes and whiskers. (3) A black cat with very large yellow eyes and a chef hat uses a white piping bag. It carefully squeezes white cream into the heart molds. A small purple bucket sits nearby on the counter as the conveyor moves. It looks happy with a slight blush on its cheeks against the pink background. (7) All four animated cats (calico, orange, black, and yellow) cluster together in the center of the frame. Brown cursive text 'Happy Valentine's Day' appears in an arch above them, decorated with small white chef hat icons.
